svg.title: The primary incident model stays unavailable
svg.desc: Place the unavailable primary incident model outside the analysis tree with a closed boundary. Absence of access must remain concrete rather than a faint footnote. Visual distinction: A firm source edge with incomplete outer brackets. The blank gutter marks the limit of review, not destruction or proof of absence.
